result.summary: The two independent uniform-hole replicates agreed on 23/32 continuation-CVaR2of3 actions and had positive aggregate lower95 deltas in both replicates, but 7/23 consensus rows were negative in at least one of six replicate-by-continuation cells, worst-six-way lower95 was -1.7397 bb, and 8/23 selected a new highest-risk slot.
result.conclusion: Do not train the consensus point labels or treat aggregate positive means as sufficient while all-continuation tails and highest-risk transitions fail.
result.next_step: Change the action-history-conditioned opponent-hole posterior, continuation distribution, or learn a distributional/pairwise target that explicitly preserves uncertainty rather than taking a point argmax.
